summary.name: Meta Developer Platform (llama.com)
summary.one_liner: Meta's developer hub for its Muse model family, offering the Muse Code terminal coding agent, a Meta Model API, and open-weight models such as Muse Spark Open and SAM 3.1.
use_cases: computer use automation for browsers and apps
calling Meta models through an OpenAI-compatible API
detecting and tracking objects in images and video
running open-weight models locally or self-hosted
summary.what_it_does: The page is a product hub for Meta's current Muse models and developer tools. Muse Code is a terminal tool for multi-agent coding, installable on Mac and Windows. Meta Model API provides direct, self-serve access to Muse models, and the page says it is compatible with the OpenAI SDK. Muse Spark Open is described as an 816B open-weight model that can be served with SGLang, vLLM or Apple MLX, run on hosted APIs, or fine-tuned. The model list also includes SAM 3.1 for text-prompted object detection and segmentation in image and video, Muse Voice Transcribe for speech-to-text, and Muse Glimmer, available on Hugging Face for local agents. Documentation, cookbooks and quickstarts cover topics such as search grounding and computer use.
notable: Muse Spark Open is described as an 816B open-weight model that can be self-served with SGLang, vLLM or Apple MLX
Muse Code is a terminal multi-agent coding tool, out of beta per the page
Meta Model API is OpenAI SDK compatible
Muse Glimmer is designed for always-on local agents and is available on Hugging Face
caveats: Pricing details are not stated on the page; it mentions only 'affordable' and 'new plans' for Muse Code without figures
Listing describes Llama as free for research and most commercial use, but the page itself focuses on the Muse model family and does not restate Llama licence terms
Muse Code is listed for Mac and Windows only
